meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth, including Tip: lines in the TUI. Use when the user asks about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入解释每条 senpi 提示，让界面功能一目了然
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果使用 senpi 时常想弄懂界面上的每句提示
copy.tagline_en: Explain any senpi tip in depth to see what each feature does
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often wonder what each tip in senpi means

howto.what: 当用户问起界面上某条'Tip:'提示或功能提示时，Claude会先查看当前实际可见的提示，再阅读相关代码核实真实机制，最后用提问者所用的语言深入解释并注明代码文件；文字与代码冲突时以代码为准。
howto.when: 当用户问起“Tip:”提示的含义、被提示的功能是如何工作的，或自己能看到哪些提示时，Claude会接管回答。

say.text: 刚才那条'Tip:'里说的重试机制，具体是怎么判断要不要重试的？
say.note: Claude会查出这条提示对应代码，深入解释判断逻辑。

say.text: 我现在能看到哪些提示？哪些被开启了？
say.note: Claude会读取当前设置，列出你实际可见的提示及原因。

say.text: 提示说拒绝后会走架构师通道，这个通道到底怎么回事？

howto.what_en: When asked about a senpi tip or 'Tip:' line, Claude checks which tips are actually visible now, reads the relevant source to verify the mechanism, then explains in depth in the user's language, citing files. If code and tip text conflict, code wins.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks what a 'Tip:' line means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips they can see.

say_en.text: What exactly is the retry mechanism behind that 'Tip:' line?
say_en.note: Claude locates the code for the tip and explains its actual logic.

say_en.text: Which tips can I currently see, and which ones are enabled?
say_en.note: Claude reads settings and lists tips you can actually encounter.

say_en.text: The tip says after a refusal it goes through an architect channel—how?
say_en.note: For the Fable-5 refusal tip, Claude explains the fallback pipeline.
